input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF009",
  "title": "Rising edge batch counter with reset sampling",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# SELF009: Rising-Edge Batch Part Counter\n\n## Background\nRising-edge batch counter validating integer `Target` in `1..20`.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `PartPulse`, `Reset` (`BOOL`), `Target` (`INT`, valid domain `1..20`). Edge memory `previous_pulse` initializes `FALSE` and updates to `I[k].PartPulse` on EVERY scan (including `Error` or `Reset`).\n2. If `Target` is outside `1..20`, set `Error := TRUE`, `Count := 0`, `Complete := FALSE`.\n3. Else `Error := FALSE`: if `Reset = TRUE`, set `Count := 0` and `Complete := FALSE`; otherwise increment `Count := min(Count + 1, Target)` on `PartPulse` rising edge (`PartPulse AND NOT previous_pulse`) and set `Complete := (Count >= Target)`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `PartPulse: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`, `Target: USINT`\n- **Outputs:** `Count: USINT`, `Complete: BOOL`, `Error: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Count=0`, `previous_pulse=false`, `Complete=false`, `Error=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\n`Target` must be an integer (`bool` rejected). Shrinking `Target` clamps `Count` via `min(..., Target)` and re-evaluates `Complete`.",
  "scenario": "A packaging batch counts individual sensor edges and prevents a held sensor during reset from being counted again.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "PartPulse",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Part detection level"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Reset batch"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Target",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Batch target, valid 1 through 20"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Count",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Saturated part count"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Complete",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Target reached"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Error",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Invalid target"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Count": 0,
    "previous_pulse": false,
    "Complete": false,
    "Error": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Invalid Target and Reset override counting",
    "Update edge memory on every scan"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "PartPulse": "I[k].PartPulse: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Reset": "I[k].Reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Target": "I[k].Target: sampled input (USINT).",
    "Count": "O[k].Count: independently observed post-scan candidate value (USINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "Complete": "O[k].Complete: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Error": "O[k].Error: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "invalid": "Target < 1 or Target > 20.",
    "rise": "PartPulse & !qPulse.",
    "qPulse": "{\"kind\": \"previous_sampled_input\", \"source\": \"I[k-1].PartPulse\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After EVERY scan k, including invalid/reset/stop, store I[k].PartPulse\"}",
    "qCount": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Count\", \"initial\": 0, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Count; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "countAfterEdge": "min(qCount + (1 if rise else 0), Target).",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Count=0, O_init.Complete=false, O_init.Error=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P1",
      "formula": "G(Error <-> invalid)",
      "explanation": "Target validation is exact.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P2",
      "formula": "G((Reset | invalid) -> ((Count = 0) & !Complete))",
      "explanation": "Reset or invalid target clears the batch.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P3",
      "formula": "G((!Reset & !invalid) -> (Count = countAfterEdge))",
      "explanation": "Only rising edges add an item, with saturation.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P4",
      "formula": "G((!Reset & !invalid) -> (Complete <-> (Count >= Target)))",
      "explanation": "Complete reports the post-scan count.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF009.P5",
      "formula": "G(X(qPulse) <-> PartPulse)",
      "explanation": "Edge memory samples the pulse even during reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
